categories.main_business_segments: Chengdu ALD Aviation Manufacturing Corporation primarily operates in the aerospace manufacturing sector, focusing on precision manufacturing of military and civil aircraft parts, aero-engine components, and large aerospace structural parts. The company also engages in the design and development of aircraft fuel system products. Its business segments include CNC precision machining, special process treatment, component assembly, and product design and development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced CNC precision machining, including 3D printing for complex materials and parts, special process treatments such as anodizing, non-destructive testing, electroplating, acid pickling, heat treatment, and painting. It has developed integrated manufacturing capabilities covering the entire process from raw material procurement to final assembly. The firm emphasizes innovation in complex part processing, new materials, and intelligent manufacturing technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic and international aerospace manufacturers such as China Aviation Industry Corporation subsidiaries, COMAC, Airbus, Boeing, Safran, and other military and civil aviation entities. The company serves military aircraft, civil aircraft, unmanned aerial vehicles, and aerospace sectors. Its markets span military modernization programs, civil aviation growth driven by projects like the C919, and emerging low-altitude economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main production facilities located in Chengdu, Sichuan Province. It serves both domestic and international aerospace markets, including direct business with global aerospace companies such as Airbus and Boeing. Sales are concentrated in the Sichuan region but expanding to other domestic and international regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: Chengdu ALD Aviation Manufacturing Corporation operates mainly in the midstream of the aerospace supply chain, providing precision manufacturing and assembly of aircraft components and systems. It integrates upstream raw material procurement and downstream assembly and product design, positioning itself as a full-process supplier offering one-stop services from machining to final assembly.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes technological innovation and R&D investment, focusing on advanced manufacturing technologies such as 3D printing, complex material processing, and aircraft fuel system product development. It aims to build intelligent manufacturing centers and expand product design capabilities. Strategic R&D initiatives include improving machining precision, developing new materials, and integrating AI and digital tools into design and production processes.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of precision-manufactured aerospace components and assemblies to military and civil aviation manufacturers. The company operates on an order-based production model, providing customized manufacturing and assembly services. It also earns income from product design services and maintenance of aerospace parts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major aerospace component manufacturers domestically and internationally, including subsidiaries of China Aviation Industry Corporation, COMAC, and global aerospace suppliers. It holds a leading position as a core supplier to key military and civil aviation manufacturers in China and has established strategic partnerships with international aerospace firms, enhancing its competitive standing.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately 301 million RMB, a 13.91% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about 25 million RMB. Despite short-term profit declines due to price reductions and order fluctuations, the company maintains substantial asset size with total assets around 2.09 billion RMB. It continues to invest heavily in R&D and capital projects, aiming for long-term growth and industry leadership.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Chengdu ALD Aviation Manufacturing Corporation differentiates itself through its integrated full-process manufacturing capabilities, combining CNC precision machining, specialized process treatments, assembly, and product design. Its focus on complex, high-precision aerospace components, advanced materials, and intelligent manufacturing technologies provides customers with high-quality, reliable, and innovative aerospace products. The company emphasizes strong quality control, technological innovation, and strategic customer partnerships to deliver superior value.
